how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-razorfen-downs-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:3341:obj:0: Andrew Brownell wants you to kill Amnennar the Coldbringer and return his skull.
rows.quest:3341:details:0: In the ⟦E1⟧ lies a horrid mess of tangled vines called Razorfen Downs. While our first observations of this place revealed little threat, our recent findings are much more serious...
rows.quest:3341:details:1: BThe quilboar of Razorfen Downs have aligned themselves with the Scourge. A Lich named Amnennar the Coldbringer rules them now, using the power of his massive consciousness to control their every move.
rows.quest:3341:details:2: BAmnennar has a direct telepathic link to Ner'zhul; we must sever this bond, ⟦1⟧. An end must come to the Coldbringer.
rows.quest:3341:completion:0: The loyalty of a Lich is unswerving, ⟦2⟧. Let them know that such loyalty will only bring them destruction.
rows.quest:3523:obj:0: If you agree to aid Belnistrasz, speak with him again and hand the Oathstone he gave you back to him.
rows.quest:3523:details:0: Outstanding! My name is Belnistrasz, and I thank you for rescuing me. I had given myself up for dead... or worse, as a meal for these Scourge-infested vermin. Yes - I said Scourge all right; they've brokered some sort of deal with the Quilboar here, and this nightmare is a result.
rows.quest:3523:details:1: BListen... rather than just flee, I want to make a difference for all of our sakes. Would you be up to helping me out to that end? It's probably dangerous, but you seem to be the type not to worry about that too much.
rows.quest:3523:completion:0: Fantastic, I thought you looked to be the heroic type! We've got our work cut out for us ⟦3⟧, I'm not going to lie to you. If we stay focused on the task at hand, we should be able to come out on top.
rows.quest:3523:completion:1: BNow, let me bring you up to speed on what's been going on...
rows.quest:3525:obj:0: Escort Belnistrasz to the Quilboar's idol in Razorfen Downs.
rows.quest:3525:obj:1: BProtect Belnistrasz while he performs the ritual to shut down the idol.
rows.quest:3525:details:0: Near the entrance is an idol that functions as a macabre oven for the Quilboar; the beasts... they literally consume their abductees from the ⟦E1⟧. I can shut down the idol and bind them from using it again, but I need your aid in doing so. My plan: escort me to the idol. Once we arrive, I'll commence the ritual. I'll barely be able to communicate with you, let alone defend myself. Protect me while I shut down the idol. If they take me down, then it's all over for us.
rows.quest:3525:completion:0: Belnistrasz's sudden departure has left behind a burning brazier. As you stare in to the flame, the image of a great-winged red dragon fills your mind. A more graveled version of Belnistrasz's voice speaks directly to you.
rows.quest:3525:completion:1: B"Indeed mortals, you are the heroes I had hoped you would be. Thanks to you the butchery these beasts were perpetrating is a thing of the past. My faith in mortals such as yourself has been once more renewed. Take this as a reward befitting of a hero."
rows.quest:3636:obj:0: Archbishop Bendictus wants you to slay Amnennar the Coldbringer in Razorfen Downs.
rows.quest:3636:details:0: The Scourge is a persistent threat to the ⟦E2⟧, a fact I am sure you know quite well. Recently, we have come across some very peculiar findings, ⟦4⟧.
rows.quest:3636:details:1: BIn the ⟦E1⟧ lies a horrid tangle of briars called Razorfen Downs. While once it was the home of simple quilboar, now it has become apparent that a pact was made with the Scourge, creating creatures far worse... They are now ruled by the lich, Amnennar the Coldbringer.
rows.quest:3636:details:2: BAlign yourself with the Light, ⟦5⟧; put an end to this evil union.
rows.quest:3636:completion:0: Thank you , ⟦6⟧. The Scourge will now think twice before attempting to bolster its ranks again.
rows.quest:3636:completion:1: BMay you be blessed by the Light.
rows.quest:6521:obj:0: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:6521:details:0: Malcin claims he is outside Razorfen Downs. This ambassador must be slain--his mission a failure in the eyes of the Lich King.
rows.quest:6521:details:1: BHis presence there does explain much of what we've discovered about the area--some of the quilboar have grown frightfully powerful while showing signs of the Plague in their own way. Truly that must be a sign of some sort of deal they've struck.
rows.quest:6521:details:2: BFind Malcin and slay him, ⟦7⟧. Return to me after the deed is done.
rows.quest:6521:completion:1: BNow that Malcin is dead, we can at least know that the Scourges advances will be halted. The Dark Lady thanks you for your efforts and wishes to reward you with a gift.
rows.quest:6521:completion:2: BAlthough we do not know the extent of the Scourges influence within the Downs, I am sure we will discover their plots soon enough.
rows.quest:6522:obj:0: Take the Small Scroll to Varimathras in the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:6522:details:1: BYou know very well what it is we are offering. The opportunity for you to take the ⟦E1⟧ and the lands beyond is a great one. We simply want your aid in return. By aid we mean nothing more than your giving us the freedom to take action in the area.
rows.quest:6522:details:2: BPlease, allow us to discuss this further. We have great power and are willing to share with those wise enough to join us. I will remain outside Razorfen Downs for the time being.
rows.quest:6522:completion:0: I recognize the insignia on this scroll, ⟦10⟧. You found this on that crone who reigns over Razorfen Kraul? Interesting.
rows.quest:6522:completion:1: BThe Scourge aren't content with one continent it seems. This Ambassador Malcin--the one who wrote the note--is one of the Scourge's plagued servants, a human diplomat to the kingdom of Lordaeron before things... changed.
rows.quest:6522:completion:2: BIf the Scourge are trying to gain a foothold in ⟦E4⟧, then it is up to us to act.
rows.quest:6626:obj:0: Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.
rows.quest:6626:details:0: The ⟦E5⟧ do not pass on their... illness... from what I have seen. This diplomat seems to be granting undeath to would-be followers. I am beginning to think he is one of the Scourge.
rows.quest:6626:details:1: BFor now, my concern is not with him though, it's with the growing ranks around him. They creep from the shadows daily, almost begging him for more power.
rows.quest:6626:details:2: BI'm not powerful enough to fight them on my own, ⟦11⟧. What do you say? Are you up for some hunting?
rows.quest:6626:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦12⟧! The work you've done will be a great help, I'm sure.
rows.quest:6626:completion:1: BI will continue my study of this diplomat and the rest of the quilboar here. If you seek greater adventure, I'd find a few friends and head into the cave that looks like a great boar maw just over there. I'm sure once you're inside you'll find greater challenges to face.
